newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy stock derivatives suspended on technicality.
newsitem.headline: Italy stock derivatives suspended on technicality.

text.p: Trade in derivatives on the Italian stock market was suspended due to a technical hitch and new opening times would be announced later, the stock market council said.
Trading on futures and options was halted earlier and had been due to resume shortly before 1300 local time (1100 GMT).
The council said those opening times had now been cancelled as technical problems persisted.
